criteria.statement: Processor parses the Kind 10100 telemetry content field into canonical Worker.Telemetry.

Pressure assessment maps nominal, warning memory, critical reclaimable disk, critical thermal, missing telemetry, and hot/warm standby reserve cases to the expected pressure level, capacity class, and action.
Processor reloads canonical worker state after upsert, persists the assessment, and publishes worker.telemetry.observed only for non-stale advertisements.
